title: How is the Term 'Harm' Being Interpreted and Documented on Hospice DNACPR Forms Following the Tracey Judgement?
brief_summary: To investigate how discussions surrounding Do Not Attempt Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (DNACPR) decisions have changed following the Tracey judgement and how "harm" is being defined by clinicians working within specialist palliative care in a hospice setting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who died in 2013 or 2015 known to the individual hospice team (in-patient unit, day unit or community team)
* Completed DNACPR form within the clinical notes which was completed in 2013 or 2015

Exclusion Criteria:

* No completed DNACPR form within the clinical notes
* DNACPR form not completed in 2013 or 2015
study_population: Deceased patients' notes will be reviewed from 2013 (prior to the Tracey judgement) and from 2015 (following the Tracey judgement).
